name: Water Quality, Potability, Filtration & Treatment Runtime
design_rules: water quality is represented by separate turbidity, pathogen and chemical loads
potability depends on all critical quality dimensions rather than a single clean/dirty flag
boiling is highly effective against pathogens but does not remove chemical contamination
sedimentation and cloth filtration mainly reduce suspended particles
charcoal-based filtration can reduce some chemical load
multiple treatment steps may be combined in sequence
treated water quality persists until mixed with new water
water quality never uses emissive or glow feedback
